C0-PoolBalanced.pool: same independently initialized eight SwiGLU experts as C1
C0-PoolBalanced.schedule: (absolute input position + 2*step) mod8, adjacent partner; independent of input representation

C0-PoolFixed.note: only two experts trained; not an effective-capacity match

decision_rule: effect >=1% relative NLL, >=2/3 seed sign agreement, paired document intervals reported separately; matched control must not explain away effect; no scientific claim from freeze alone
matching_note: P matches total parameters and reports extra FLOPs; F matches active matrix cost and reports parameter deficit; do not claim both matched when impossible
pilot_trigger: relative NLL or counterfactual gain >=1% is only a follow-up design signal, never single-seed statistical confirmation

review_budget.activation: future independent decision only; excluded from current12M Pilot

trigger.H2: C1 pooled mean NLL improves over C0 by >=1% and >=2/3 seeds favor C1, OR normal-vs-random/fixed route gain >=1% with >=2/3 positive seeds
trigger.H3: C2 pooled mean NLL improves over C1 by >=1% with >=2/3 positive seeds; require State-Off consistency before claiming controller utility
